fields.climate: tropical; moderated by southeast trade winds from May to October; moderate rainfall from November to April; may be affected by cyclones from December to April
fields.terrain: mostly mountainous islands of volcanic origin; narrow coastal plains
fields.hazards: tropical cyclones (January to April); volcanic activity; volcanism also causes minor earthquakes; tsunamis; volcanism: significant volcanic activity with multiple eruptions in recent years…
fields.farm: coconuts, oranges, yams, cabbages, taro, bananas, chillies/peppers, chestnuts, sweet potatoes, cassava
fields.exports: fish, ships, perfume plants, wood, copra
fields.industries: food and fish freezing, wood processing, meat canning
fields.languages: indigenous languages (more than 100) 82.6%, Bislama (official; creole) 14.5%, English (official) 2.1%, French (official) 0.8%
fields.religions: Protestant 39.9% (Presbyterian 27.2%, Seventh Day Adventist 14.8%, Anglican 12%, Churches of Christ 5%, Assemblies of God 4.9%, Neil Thomas Ministry/Inner Life Ministry 3.2%), Roman Catholic 12.1%…
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, French law, and customary law
